references.text: Reference to the place the Lord will choose, the same expression used for the chosen place of worship
The context describing going to the priests and the judge to obtain a ruling in difficult cases
The continuation commanding obedience to the law and judgment without turning to the right or to the left
The priests shall teach the children of Israel all the laws the Lord has given them
Command to carefully follow everything the Levitical priesthood teaches
Ezra studied the Lord's law in order to obey it and to teach Israel its statutes and rules
The lips of the priest should preserve knowledge, and people should seek the law from his mouth
Jesus says that the scribes and Pharisees sit on Moses' seat, so you must do what they say
